description: Author the comprehensive Senior-QA-Engineer audit report at /projects/sandbox/kiro-web-playground/QA_AUDIT_REPORT.md, grounded entirely in the evidence gathered in FEAT-001 and in the actual source. The report must contain all 9 deliverable sections the user requested and must be honest about scope: this app is a single static landing page, so large portions of the requested audit scope (forms, modals, dropdowns, tables, search bars, filters, pagination, CRUD, routing/redirects beyond '/', authentication, authorization, sessions, tokens, password masking, APIs) target features that DO NOT EXIST and must be reported as 'Not Applicable / feature absent' with a one-line reason, NOT fabricated as bugs. Thoroughly audit what IS present.
steps: Read .agents/tasks/task-qa-audit/evidence/* (build.log, lint.log, runtime.md, headers.log, README.md) and re-read app/page.tsx, app/layout.tsx, app/globals.css, next.config.ts to ground every finding in fact. Do NOT invent findings.

Write /projects/sandbox/kiro-web-playground/QA_AUDIT_REPORT.md as a single markdown document with these sections in order: (1) QA Summary, (2) Bug Report Table, (3) Detailed Bug Reports, (4) UX Improvement Suggestions, (5) Security Findings, (6) Accessibility Findings, (7) Performance Findings, (8) Production Readiness Score (0-100), (9) Final Recommendation.

Section 1 QA Summary: state Total pages tested (1: '/'), Total tests executed (count the scope items actually exercisable), Passed, Failed, Blocked. Include a clearly labeled 'Not Applicable (feature absent)' list enumerating the scope items that do not exist in this codebase (forms, modals, dropdowns, tables, search, filters, pagination, CRUD, multi-route navigation/redirects, auth/authorization, sessions, tokens, password masking, APIs) each with a one-line reason.

Section 2 Bug Report Table: markdown table with columns | ID | Severity | Priority | Component | Description |. Each row maps to a real, evidence-backed issue. Candidate real issues to assess and include if confirmed: (a) metadata title/description still the default 'Create Next App' / 'Generated by create next app' (layout.tsx); (b) globals.css body font-family hardcoded to Arial/Helvetica/sans-serif overriding the Geist/--font-sans setup -- a genuine font inconsistency; (c) the two in-paragraph external links (Templates, Learning) use target default and lack rel=noopener noreferrer, and lack target=_blank for new-tab vs the CTA links -- inconsistent link behavior / minor security-hygiene note; (d) missing security response headers (CSP, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, HSTS, Permissions-Policy) per headers.log; (e) any console/build/lint warnings actually observed; (f) accessibility items actually observed (e.g. single h1 only / no landmarks beyond main, focus-indicator observations, color-contrast of zinc-600 text). Only include issues the evidence supports.

Section 3 Detailed Bug Reports: for every row in the table, provide Title, Description, Severity (Critical/High/Medium/Low), Priority (P0/P1/P2/P3), Steps to Reproduce, Expected Result, Actual Result, Suggested Fix, and Screenshot reference (from qa-screenshots/) where applicable. Suggested fixes that touch markup must use responsive Tailwind utility classes and semantic HTML per steering/demo.md.

Section 4 UX Improvement Suggestions: concrete, grounded suggestions (e.g. meaningful metadata/title, consistent link treatment, semantic landmarks header/footer/nav if the page grows, visible skip link). Keep them actionable.

Section 5 Security Findings: report the missing security headers from headers.log, the rel=noopener consideration on external links, and explicitly state that auth/authorization/session/token/password/input-sanitization checks are Not Applicable because no such features, inputs, or protected routes exist. Note there are no forms so XSS/SQLi/validation payload testing has no entry point (state this as N/A with reason, do not fabricate).

Section 6 Accessibility Findings: report real observations from runtime evidence and source -- image alt text present on both next/image uses, lang=en set, heading structure, landmark usage (only <main>, no <header>/<footer>/<nav>), keyboard tab order and focus-indicator observations, and color-contrast assessment of the muted zinc-600/zinc-400 body text against its background. Reference WCAG levels where you make a contrast claim.

Section 7 Performance Findings: use build.log (bundle/first-load sizes if reported), the use of next/image with priority on the logo, next/font, number of network requests, and any layout-shift observations. Note the app is tiny/static so load is fast; call out anything the evidence shows.

Section 8 Production Readiness Score (0-100): a single number with a short justification that reflects the real state (functional static page, but default metadata, missing security headers, font inconsistency, minor a11y gaps).

Section 9 Final Recommendation: pick exactly one of 'Ready for Production', 'Ready with Minor Fixes', 'Needs Major Fixes', 'Do Not Release', with a one-paragraph justification consistent with the findings.

Throughout, reference screenshots in qa-screenshots/ by relative path where they support a finding. Ensure severity/priority are assigned consistently and the counts in Section 1 reconcile with the number of rows in Section 2.
acceptance_criteria: /projects/sandbox/kiro-web-playground/QA_AUDIT_REPORT.md exists and contains all 9 numbered deliverable sections in the required order.

Section 1 includes Total pages tested, Total tests executed, Passed, Failed, Blocked counts AND an explicit 'Not Applicable (feature absent)' list covering forms/modals/dropdowns/tables/search/filters/pagination/CRUD/multi-route routing/auth/authorization/sessions/tokens/password/APIs, each with a one-line reason.

Section 2 is a markdown table with exactly the columns | ID | Severity | Priority | Component | Description | and every row corresponds to an evidence-backed issue (no fabricated bugs for absent features).
Every bug in the table has a matching detailed report in Section 3 with Title, Description, Severity, Priority, Steps, Expected, Actual, Suggested Fix, and screenshot reference where applicable.
Each severity value is one of Critical/High/Medium/Low and each priority is one of P0/P1/P2/P3.
Sections 5, 6, 7 are present; absent-feature scope items are labeled Not Applicable with reasons rather than reported as defects.
Section 8 gives a single 0-100 score with justification; Section 9 gives exactly one of the four allowed recommendations.
Any suggested markup fix in the report uses responsive Tailwind utility classes and semantic HTML (steering/demo.md).
The report's claimed build/lint/console/network/header results match the FEAT-001 evidence files.
verification: Confirm /projects/sandbox/kiro-web-playground/QA_AUDIT_REPORT.md exists and grep it for all nine section headings.
Spot-check that each ID in the Section 2 table appears in a Section 3 detailed report.
Cross-check a sample of report claims (metadata default title, Arial body font, missing security headers) against layout.tsx, globals.css, and evidence/headers.log.
findings:
Authored /projects/sandbox/kiro-web-playground/QA_AUDIT_REPORT.md with all 9 required sections in order (verified via grep: lines 13/66/81/227/240/261/280/295/303). Report is grounded entirely in FEAT-001 evidence (build.log, lint.log, runtime.md, headers.log) and direct source review of layout.tsx, page.tsx, globals.css, next.config.ts; no fabricated findings.

Section 1 counts: 1 page tested, 15 tests executed, 9 passed, 6 failed, 0 blocked. The 6 failed tests reconcile with the 6 rows in the Section 2 bug table. Section 1 also includes an explicit 'Not Applicable (feature absent)' table covering forms, modals, dropdowns, tables, search, filters, pagination, CRUD, multi-route routing/redirects, auth, authorization, sessions, tokens, password masking, APIs, and XSS/SQLi/payload each with a one-line reason.

Six evidence-backed bugs: BUG-001 default metadata (Medium/P1), BUG-002 Arial body font overriding Geist (Low/P2), BUG-003 inconsistent external-link target/rel (Low/P2), BUG-004 all six security headers absent (Medium/P1), BUG-005 X-Powered-By present (Low/P2), BUG-006 only <main> landmark (Low/P3). Report cross-checks verified against layout.tsx (default title), globals.css (Arial body), and headers.log (six absent headers + X-Powered-By present).
